inputs.label: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault (PC)
inputs.help: Your installed PC copy of Medal of Honor: Allied Assault. qgp copies every .pk3 from its main folder.

inputs.label: autoexec.cfg from the OpenMoHAA VR release
inputs.help: Download autoexec.cfg from the same GitHub release as the APK (https://github.com/bearstonem/openmohaa-vr/releases). Use the one that matches the installed version.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/org.openmoh.openmohaa/files on the first launch, and the app makes its own main/save and main/configs folders.
The guide stops the app after pushing autoexec.cfg so the next start reads it.

steps.text: Open OpenMoHAA from Library > Unknown Sources in the headset.

notes: Guided because autoexec.cfg is a second release asset that qgp cannot download yet; qgp could fetch it from the same release later. The guide says not to start the app with adb shell am start; the launch step may do exactly that, so check it. detect uses Pak0.pk3, which is not named in the guide or payload (the payload only matches *.pk3); confirm the file name. No store install: MOHAA is not listed on Steam or GOG in the payload. All releases are pre-releases.
